ZERO-WRITE-GATE.note: Mandatory, whole-suite. A read-only stage (competitor-intelligence, investigator, analyst, verifier, qa) that attempts ANY write, including under OS temp, fails this gate.
ZERO-WRITE-GATE.method: node agent/workflow/pipeline/tools/check-agent-writes.mjs (static contract + detector battery; --events-dir=<run-dir> scans real per-stage tool events during a behavioral run)
must: every read-only agent .md carries the zero-write contract
the detector rejects every write vector in the battery and allows every read-only call in the battery
must_not: a write attempt by a read-only stage classified as non-blocking because it targeted OS temp
a read-only stage's artifact forwarded after a write attempt

SANDBOX-MANIFEST-GATE.note: Mandatory, whole-suite. The sandbox must contain exactly the files declared in fixtures/sandbox-manifest.json (18 fixtures + 2 schema contracts) and nothing else; each role receives only the subset its `roles` entry allows.
must: sandbox-manifest.json lists exactly 18 fixture + 2 contract entries
every entry's sha256 matches its source
a built sandbox holds exactly the manifest files, no more, no fewer
must_not: an undeclared file present in the sandbox
a schema missing from the sandbox
a role receiving a file its roles list does not name

STRICT-JSON-GATE.note: Mandatory, whole-suite. Every one of the six agents' replies is exactly one JSON object before it is handed off.
must: each agent .md carries the strict-output contract
the parser battery passes: single object, fenced, prose-before, prose-after, two-objects, and unjustified-HTML-escaping cases all resolve as expected
must_not: a reply with text outside the single JSON object forwarded to the next stage
a fenced or HTML-escaped reply accepted as a handoff

RETRY-GATE.note: Mandatory, whole-suite. Bounded format-retry protocol per pipeline-guardrails.json -> format_retry_policy. Applies only to STRICT-JSON-GATE / schema failures, never to a semantic outcome (qa FAIL, verifier REFUTED, etc. route back through the normal flow instead).
must: format_retry_policy documented in pipeline-guardrails.json with max_attempts_total == 3
each agent .md carries the format-retry reissue note

E2E-MED.note: Full MEDIU chain: Investigator -> Analyst -> Verifier CONFIRMED -> Implementer -> QA -> ESCALATE -> AWAITING_LAURA_APPROVAL. The /bueroreinigung fixture family (f05 raw finding, f10 investigation shape, f09 verifier input) is self-contained and adequately powered: gap-query panel 3000 impressions / 30 clicks over 28 days => impression-weighted CTR exactly 30/3000 = 1.00%; sibling benchmark 140 clicks / 3500 impressions = 4.00% impression-weighted over the matched query intents; six header-change control pages all move <=4%, separating the still-unexplained 2026-08-18 decline from the verified content-gap opportunity. A rigorous Verifier therefore reaches overall == CONFIRMED on the merits. ROUTE_BACK / REFUTED / INSUFFICIENT_DATA is a FAIL for this test; the expectation is NOT relaxed to let ROUTE_BACK pass.
must: implementer builds only the test scaffold in the temp repo (no production-shaped change)
must_not: any write in the official repo
any network fetch by any agent
any real PSS commercial figure in any artifact

must: pipeline halts at the approval gate

E2E-CMP-MINOR.note: A minor competitor change that is NOT a duplicate. The Investigator does not archive it — it routes TO_ANALYST; the Analyst returns IGNORE or MONITOR; the Coordinator then archives. ARCHIVE_MINOR is reserved for confirmed duplicates only.

must: ends as NEEDS_MORE_DATA or verification.overall == INSUFFICIENT_DATA

E2E-DUP.note: The ONLY case that yields ARCHIVE_MINOR: a confirmed duplicate of an already-resolved finding (the prior-resolution record is embedded in the fixture).

E2E-MONITOR.note: Real but low-impact, not a duplicate. Investigator routes TO_ANALYST (never ARCHIVE_MINOR); Analyst returns MONITOR; Coordinator archives with archive_class MONITOR once all monitor conditions hold.
